diffusion_flame_specific.note: No published measurement of total visible chem power for diffusion flames. Computable route: Slack & Grillo 1985 CO2* kinetics (via Nori & Seitzman AIAA 2008-953 Eq.3) + Jin et al. 2020 ACS Omega 5:15922 calibrated CH*/OH* fields (figures only)
